result.topic_en: Riemann works with the Euler-type integral S(α,β,γ,x)=∫_0^1 y^α(1-y)^β(1-xy)^γ dy, expands it as a hypergeometric power series in Π-functions, derives the connection formula relating S(α,δ,γ,1-x) to solutions at x, and treats the logarithmic (degenerate) case α+β+1=m, δ+γ+1=-m using ψ-functions and log x.
